judgments.title: All skill test invariants pass with the new hermoso-constitution skill
Constitution skill creates docs/constitution.md with required structure

command: import os,sys; p='skills/hermoso-constitution/SKILL.md'; print('exists' if os.path.exists(p) else 'missing'); f=open(p) if os.path.exists(p) else None; c=f.read() if f else ''; print('has-create' if 'create' in c.lower() else 'no-create'); print('has-amend' if 'amend' in c.lower() else 'no-amend'); print('has-version' if 'version' in c.lower() else 'no-version'); print('has-principle' if 'principle' in c.lower() else 'no-principle')

criteria: skills/hermoso-constitution/SKILL.md exists and has valid frontmatter with name starting hermoso-constitution
The skill describes interactive constitution creation with clarifying questions
The skill describes constitution amendment with version bump and sync impact report
The skill writes to docs/constitution.md only, never to .hermoso/
The skill contains .hermoso prohibition and never infer context language

judgments.title: Constitution skill describes amendment with version bump

command: import os; p='skills/hermoso-constitution/SKILL.md'; f=open(p) if os.path.exists(p) else None; c=f.read() if f else ''; print('has-amend' if 'amend' in c.lower() else 'no-amend'); print('has-version-bump' if 'version' in c.lower() and 'bump' in c.lower() else 'no-version-bump'); print('has-sync-impact' if 'sync' in c.lower() or 'impact' in c.lower() else 'no-sync-impact')

criteria: The skill describes an amendment process that bumps the constitution version
The skill describes a sync impact report noting changed principles
The amendment process preserves existing principles unless explicitly removed

judgments.title: Design skill blocks when no constitution exists

command: import os; p='skills/hermoso-design/SKILL.md'; f=open(p) if os.path.exists(p) else None; c=f.read() if f else ''; print('has-constitution-check' if 'constitution' in c.lower() else 'no-constitution-check'); print('has-block-no-constitution' if 'block' in c.lower() and 'constitution' in c.lower() else 'no-block'); print('has-run-constitution-first' if 'constitution' in c.lower() and ('run' in c.lower() or 'first' in c.lower()) else 'no-run-first')

criteria: hermoso-design SKILL.md contains a constitution check step at the entry gate
The skill blocks and directs the user to run the hermoso-constitution skill if docs/constitution.md does not exist
The constitution check occurs before Phase 1 (Clarify)

judgments.title: Design skill blocks on constitution principle violations

command: import os; p='skills/hermoso-design/SKILL.md'; f=open(p) if os.path.exists(p) else None; c=f.read() if f else ''; print('has-violation-check' if 'violation' in c.lower() or 'violate' in c.lower() else 'no-violation-check'); print('has-block-put' if 'design put' in c.lower() and 'block' in c.lower() else 'no-block-put'); print('has-principle-check' if 'principle' in c.lower() else 'no-principle-check')

criteria: The design skill checks the feature design against each constitution principle
The skill blocks before design put if a principle is violated without escape-hatch override
The skill reports which principle is violated when blocking

command: import os; p='skills/hermoso-design/SKILL.md'; f=open(p) if os.path.exists(p) else None; c=f.read() if f else ''; print('has-escape-hatch' if 'escape' in c.lower() and 'hatch' in c.lower() else 'no-escape-hatch'); print('has-override' if 'override' in c.lower() else 'no-override'); print('has-decisions' if 'decisions' in c.lower() else 'no-decisions'); print('has-rationale' if 'rationale' in c.lower() else 'no-rationale')

criteria: The skill describes an escape-hatch override mechanism
Overrides are declared in the design's decisions array with rationale
The skill requires explicit user approval before proceeding with an override
Overrides are visible in the design doc
